rescope_proposal: Measure ambiguous-authority calibration/stability as a narrowed descriptive study; exclude absent/underfilled strata from any safety or whole-policy claim.

wilson_n50.interpretation: ECE/Brier/selective accuracy are computable but case-level intervals are wide enough that a gate pass is not strong evidence of transferable quality.

questions.repetition_k10: 500 observations do not substitute for 50 independent cases: K=10 measures within-case stability/variance, not population calibration or coverage.

boundary_n30.interpretation: At n=30, observed <=5% is coarse and its Wilson upper bound remains above 10%; the .74/.70 boundary behavior can be reported but not cleared as stable.

questions.safety_strata: Eight disallowed/destructive and zero credential-injection cases cannot support a whole-policy safety claim; a 907-flag denominator is not 907 policy-relevant destructive actions.

allowed_claim: COD-H2 may report a narrowed ambiguous-authority pilot: 50 cases, 30 predeclared command-characteristic boundary members, K=10 stability, per-case variance, selective curves, and labeled outcomes.
forbidden_claims: human action lift representative of the product
